I don’t have real‑time market data built into this environment, so I can’t give you the exact price right now.  
For the most up‑to‑date Bitcoin price, check a reputable source such as:

- Major exchanges (Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, etc.)  
- Financial news sites (Bloomberg, Reuters, CNBC)  
- Crypto‑price aggregators (CoinMarketCap, CoinGecko, CoinPaprika)

These platforms update the price every few seconds and will give you the current value in your preferred currency.
